title: Database out of memory
reason: The engineer correctly identified PostgreSQL as the failing component, described an OOM/memory issue, and traced it to the api 2.4.0 deployment adding a heavy query.
root_cause: The April 26 deployment of api 2.4.0 introduced a query that overloaded PostgreSQL, causing memory usage to hit ~98% and OOM kills, which restarted the DB and broke connections, leading to sales‑report errors and shop outages.
truth: api 2.4.0 added a sales report query that makes PostgreSQL use more than its 1 GB memory limit, so it is killed (out of memory, signal 9) and keeps restarting.
